rejected_iterations: v21 replaced cellular cracks with dense continuous ruler bands and was rejected.

accepted: A deterministic project-owned 1K mask replaces generic cellular world-space noise in the broad-water foam color and roughness breakup.
Sparse curved foam patches remain aligned to river coordinates and move downstream without changing the solver foam field.
The texture is evaluated only inside conditioned solver foam; calm or unmasked water cannot gain invented whitewater.
Using broken foam rather than the full foam mask for roughness removes the broad cracked-sheet response while preserving hydraulic authority.
rejected_or_open: Remaining sparse laces are still too clean and linear at hero distance and are not final photoreal whitewater art.
The broad water remains a non-overturning heightfield with insufficient crest, hole, pile and wave-train volume.
Spray and mist remain visibly card-like and require production Niagara/VFX replacement.
No named guide or art reviewer has approved the foam scale, motion, water shape or rapid fidelity.
The capture is not approved for marketing, store, trailer, press-kit or release-media use.
